defects.quote: Configure or implement a knee detector ... so a knee and verified bound load can be estimated
defects.why: A verified capacity bound does not depend on the unimplemented knee detector.

defects.quote: Implement or configure knee detection ... before estimating capacity
defects.why: This recommends changing a fixed product limitation as a prerequisite for a bound.

defects.quote: no lower_inclusive/upper_exclusive bound is derived without a configured policy
defects.why: Bounds come from verified stages with product outcomes; a required capacity is needed for a policy verdict, not for the bound itself.
